images.prompt:
Create one transparent game overlay PNG, landscape 1536 x 1024. A very thin fringe of stylized blood attaches to the uppermost edge, spanning all 1536 pixels in width. It occupies ONLY the top 150 pixels. Most drips are 40 to 85 pixels tall; exactly two longest are 145 pixels tall. Everything from row 154 through row 1023 is absolutely empty with alpha zero. Real RGBA transparency, no background of any kind, no haze, no gradient behind the fringe, no shadow outside the shapes, no glow, no detached drops. This is an isolated graphic cutout, with 85 percent of the image completely blank transparent. Deep blood red palette, no pink, magenta, orange or purple. No text, border frame, characters, bodies, objects, UI or scenery.
Follow this style exactly: STAINED GLASS: blood made of deep red and ruby stained glass pieces held by thick dark lead lines, each drip a glass shard, faint inner light variation inside each pane, no glow outside.
Keep all texture and shading strictly INSIDE the fringe silhouette. Do not fill empty space with dark red or black. Keep the blood fringe shallow and attached to the top edge.

Generate exactly one landscape PNG, 1536x1024 pixels, genuinely transparent RGBA alpha background. Only a shallow blood fringe running down from the TOP EDGE across the entire canvas width. Colors: deep blood reds only, readable on very dark screens; never pink, magenta, orange or purple. Dark structural lines permitted only when required by the specified style.
No text, frames, cards, UI, characters, weapons, wounds, organs, bodies, background scenery, solid/black backdrop, painted checkerboard or transparency visualization.
